sentence: Li's criterion is compiled over Mathlib's zeros as a two-way equivalence in the programme's kernel (li_nonneg_iff_rh, v0.9), its converse vendored from nicholasbulka/li-criterion-rh-equivalence-lean at 35df682f under Apache 2.0; equivalently, RH is the nonnegativity of the Bombieri–Lagarias arithmetic limits (arith_limit_nonneg_iff_rh).
